content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Primarily a specialty insurer bearing underwriting risk and running annuities, not an agency earning commissions from carriers."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Professional employer organization that outsources HR and payroll and underwrites workers' compensation, rather than brokering policies."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Billboard advertising and broadband internet are core businesses; insurance is only a minor segment."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Freight and utility payment processing with bank services; it does not sell insurance coverage."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Life insurer and annuity provider funding products with premiums, plus asset management; it bears insurance risk."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Manages workers' compensation and health claims costs for payers; it does not place insurance policies for customers."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced claims adjusting for insurers and self-insured employers, serving carriers rather than selling coverage to buyers."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Licensed agents place individual, family and Medicare policies and earn carrier commissions, matching the agency model across personal lines and benefits."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Underwrites and bears risk on property and casualty policies as a carrier, unlike TWFG's commission-based agency model."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Underwrites title, mortgage guaranty and general insurance as a risk-bearing carrier, plus title and escrow services."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Specialty carrier underwriting catastrophe-exposed property risks and retaining premiums, not a retail agency model."},{"label":"C12","good":true,"reason":"Insurance brokerage placing personal and commercial lines and employee benefits with carriers for commissions, closely matching TWFG's business."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Carrier writing homeowners, auto and commercial policies and bearing underwriting risk, rather than brokering coverage."},{"label":"C14","good":false,"reason":"Specialty underwriter and reinsurer that bears insured risk and invests reserves, not an agency or broker."}]}
